goals.description: Identify whether the user requested a specific test name or a package path, and resolve the package path when only a test name is provided.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on determining what tests should be run. If a specific test name is provided, find the Go package containing it. If a package path is provided, use it as the target package. Do not run tests yet.
goals.name: Determine test target

goals.description: Ensure a PostgreSQL instance for unit tests is running in Docker and that the test database exists.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on preparing PostgreSQL for the test run. Check for the storj_unit_tests_postgres container, start it if needed on port 5433 with password tmppass, wait until it accepts connections, and create the teststorj database. You may use testsuite/postgres-dev.sh if appropriate.
goals.name: Start PostgreSQL

goals.description: Run the resolved Go tests with the PostgreSQL test database connection string configured.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on executing the requested tests. Use go test -v against the resolved package, include -run when a specific test was requested, and pass -postgres-test-db 'postgres://postgres:tmppass@localhost:5433/teststorj?sslmode=disable'. Preserve output needed for reporting.
goals.name: Run PostgreSQL tests

goals.description: Summarize whether the tests passed or failed, list subtests that ran, and offer help investigating any failures.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on reporting the completed test run. State pass/fail status, list the subtests observed in the output, and if failures occurred, offer to help investigate them.
goals.name: Report test results

goals.description: Stop and remove the PostgreSQL Docker container used for the test run.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on cleanup after the test run. Remove the storj_unit_tests_postgres Docker container with docker rm -f storj_unit_tests_postgres.
goals.name: Stop PostgreSQL container
